title: Selling Plans — Chargeback Share Bands for Final Value Fee Credits
content:
The share of a variable final value fee that a chargeback credit on **Selling Plans** returns is banded by how much of the order the chargeback took back. The chargeback amount is the chargeback debits for the order on the seller's Northloop Payments ledger, added together; the proportional share is that amount divided by the order's fee basis, never above one.

**Rule.** The chargeback share is counted as one when the chargeback amount reaches at least the whole-order chargeback share of the fee basis, as half of the proportional share when it is below the minimum chargeback share, and as the proportional share between the two.

## Bands

| Chargeback amount as a share of the order's fee basis | Chargeback share used |
|---|---|
| 90% or more (the whole-order chargeback share) | One — the whole order |
| 20% or more but below 90% | The proportional share |
| Below 20% (the minimum chargeback share) | Half of the proportional share (a factor of 0.5) |

## Both sides of each band (hypothetical order with a fee basis of USD 200.00)

| Chargeback amount | Proportional share | Chargeback share used |
|---|---|---|
| USD 180.00 | 0.9 | One |
| USD 179.00 | 0.895 | 0.895 |
| USD 40.00 | 0.2 | 0.2 |
| USD 39.00 | 0.195 | Half of 0.195, which is 0.0975 |
